The 2018 year of account suffered an adverse movement, including a prior year deficit related to the 2017 AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $11.224m (7.98% of opening reserves), driven principally by deterioration on older underwriting years largely associated with quota-share treaty underperformance (AXA/XL), natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Michael and Typhoon Hagibis) and a material casualty large loss (NiSource gas explosion). The movement reflects strengthening of reserves overall across the reinsurance/treaty portfolio and selected casualty exposures.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not stated as a single gross figure in narrative or a 'movement in prior year provision' gross line. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2020) per methodology guidance. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from $'000 to millions. The report contains narrative references to net prior-year movements (percentages) and to underperforming quota-share (AXA/XL) but no single explicit gross PYD number; the triangle-derived PYD is therefore used (confidence 0.8).
